howItWorks.pageIntro: Find a space, book it, and get on with your day.

search.title: Search
search.body: Search by city, date, and room type. See real prices and real availability.

book.title: Book & pay
book.body: Pick a time, pay securely online, and get instant confirmation.

manage.title: Manage your booking
manage.body: View your bookings, get details by email or SMS, and cancel per the space's policy — all from your account.

review.title: Leave a review
review.body: After your booking, rate the space and share what it was like — it helps the next person choose.

forBusinesses.pageIntro: Turn empty hours into bookings. Spotva connects your meeting rooms, studios, and event spaces with people who need them.

reach.title: Reach real demand
reach.body: Your space shows up in search once it's approved — no separate listing fee.

control.title: You're in control
control.body: Set your own prices, availability, and booking rules.

payouts.title: Get paid reliably
payouts.body: Payments are processed securely and paid out to you for each completed booking.
